tiers.name: Free
tiers.who_its_for: Developers starting out, up to 1,000 subscribers
tiers.rationale: Matches current free tier; generous enough to attract dev audience from Buttondown free (100 subs)

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.rationale: Anchors above Buttondown add-on stack ($9+$9+$9); below Ghost Starter ($25); fair for niche value

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.rationale: Anchors well below Beehiiv Scale ($43 for 100k); justified by Git-native workflow premium

recommendation.positioning_note: Current $9/mo flat is 5x too cheap vs market; $19 Pro signals real value without scaring dev buyers.
risks: Dev audience is price-sensitive but also values ownership; $19 must be justified by shipping analytics and segmentation
Substack and Beehiiv offer free tiers up to 2.5k-10k subs; 1k free cap may slow top-of-funnel growth
No paid-subscription monetization feature limits appeal to writers who want to charge readers
